title: Patrick de Paula Shines as Sport Advances in Série B
seoTitle: Patrick de Paula Shines as Sport Advances in Série B
subtitle: Midfielder Debuts as Starter, Scores Decisive Goal, and Helps Leão Reach 50 Points
excerpt: In Série B's 32nd round, Patrick de Paula made his first start for Sport, scoring the winning goal against São Bernardo and boosting the team to 50 points.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
In the 32nd round of Série B, Sport secured a 2-1 victory over São Bernardo, reaching 50 points and climbing to seventh place. The standout player of the match was midfielder Patrick de Paula, who debuted as a starter and scored the goal that sealed the three points.

Patrick de Paula Debuts as a Starter

Chosen by Mariano Soso to fill in for the absences of Biel, who was suspended, and Fernando Sobral, who is recovering, Patrick de Paula was given the opportunity to start the match. It was the first time the midfielder played the full 90 minutes as a starter for Leão.

Decisive Goal and Offensive Involvement

The midfielder scored the only goal of the match in the 40th minute of the second half, a shot from outside the box that sealed the result. Beyond the goal, he added dynamism to the game, participated in build-up plays, and showed presence in marking, involving himself in both ball distribution and offensive actions.

Player's Emotional Reaction

After the match, Patrick de Paula stated he was emotional about the moment and thanked God for the strength to overcome a severe knee injury and various difficulties. He emphasized that the opportunity at Sport, granted after three months without playing, allowed him to demonstrate that he is fit and ready to evolve.

Impact on Sport's Campaign

The victory kept the pursuit of the promotion group alive and brought Sport closer to the G-6, which includes Atlético-GO, Fortaleza, and Criciúma. With 50 points, Leão is two points behind Atlético-GO, who leads the G-6 with 52 points. With six rounds remaining, coach Mariano Soso now has a reinforcement capable of elevating the team's performance.

Upcoming Challenges

The schedule includes clashes against Atlético-GO, Fortaleza, and Criciúma, all members of the G-6. Sport will need to win four of the remaining six games to secure their place among the top six teams.
